summary: Defines an OSPFv3-based auto-discovery mechanism for Layer 1 VPNs. It parallels the existing OSPF version 2 mechanism, with support for IPv6 as the notable difference. It is an Experimental protocol.

eli5.summary: Private links need to find each other automatically. This note gives a way for routers using the newer addressing to discover those links on their own, copying an older way that only worked with the old addressing.

questions: how does l1vpn discovery work with ipv6
